newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yen's recent rise excessive -- MITI vice minister.
newsitem.headline: Yen's recent rise excessive -- MITI vice minister.

text.p: The recent rise in the yen against the dollar is excessive, Japanese Vice Minister of International Trade and Industry Tsutomu Makino told a news conference on Monday.
Commenting on a sharp fall in the dollar to below 113 yen on Monday, Makino said: "It is an excessive rise in the yen."
"Wild currency moves are not desirable, and we will keep an eye on the moves," he said.
He said Japan's trade surplus may be a topic discussed at the summit meeting of the Group of Seven (G7) industrial nations from June 20-23.
"However, I have not heard that the trade surplus is going to be discussed as a special subject at the summit," he said.
